# Travel Ladies

> > Travel Ladies is a community platform connecting solo female travelers worldwide through travel buddy matching, hospitality exchange, and safety resources.

The platform helps women find travel companions, connect with trusted hosts for free accommodation, and access comprehensive safety information for destinations around the world. Travel Ladies fosters a supportive community for women who travel solo through meetups, local stays, and peer-to-peer connections.

## Key Topics

- solo female travel
- women travelers
- travel buddy matching
- hospitality exchange
- travel safety

- couchsurfing for women

## Core Platform Features

- [Make Friends While Traveling Solo - Travel Ladies](https://travelladies.app): Homepage for Travel Ladies app connecting solo female travelers worldwide
- [Travel Ladies | Travel Buddy App for Women](https://travelladies.app/travelbuddy): Travel buddy matching service helping women find travel partners
- [Hospitality Exchange for Women](https://travelladies.app/hospitality-exchange): Free hospitality exchange connecting female travelers with trusted hosts

## Safety & Destination Resources

- [Solo Female Travel Safety Index](https://travelladies.app/safety): Comprehensive safety index ranking destinations for solo female travelers
